payload.sql: WITH monthly_stats AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount), 2) AS sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m')) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN sales_amount END), 0) AS aug_sales_amount, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN order_count END), 0) AS aug_order_count, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN sales_amount END), 0) AS jul_sales_amount, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN order_count END), 0) AS jul_order_count, ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN sales_amount END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN sales_amount END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN sales_amount END), 0)) / COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-07' THEN sales_amount END), 0) END, 4) AS sales_mom_growth_rate FROM monthly_stats LIMIT 200

payload.sql: WITH sales_by_category AS (SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '216' DAY) GROUP BY p.category), refunds_by_category AS (SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '216' DAY) GROUP BY p.category) SELECT COALESCE(s.category, r.category) AS category, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount FROM sales_by_category AS s LEFT OUTER JOIN refunds_by_category AS r ON s.category = r.category UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(s.category, r.category) AS category, COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount FROM sales_by_category AS s RIGHT OUTER JOIN refunds_by_category AS r ON s.category = r.category WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sales_by_category AS s WHERE s.category = r.category) LIMIT 200

payload.sql: WITH user_order_summary AS (SELECT u.user_level, u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount), 0) AS user_sales_amount FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '288' DAY) GROUP BY u.user_level, u.user_id), user_refund_summary AS (SELECT u.user_level, u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS user_refund_amount FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '288' DAY) GROUP BY u.user_level, u.user_id), level_summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(o.user_level, r.user_level) AS user_level, COALESCE(SUM(o.user_sales_amount), 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.user_refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.user_sales_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.user_refund_amount), 0) AS net_income FROM user_order_summary AS o LEFT OUTER JOIN user_refund_summary AS r ON o.user_level = r.user_level AND o.user_id = r.user_id GROUP BY COALESCE(o.user_level, r.user_level) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(o.user_level, r.user_level) AS user_level, COALESCE(SUM(o.user_sales_amount), 0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.user_refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.user_sales_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.user_refund_amount), 0) AS net_income FROM user_order_summary AS o RIGHT OUTER JOIN user_refund_summary AS r ON o.user_level = r.user_level AND o.user_id = r.user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_order_summary AS o WHERE o.user_level = r.user_level AND o.user_id = r.user_id) GROUP BY COALESCE(o.user_level, r.user_level)) SELECT user_level, ROUND(sales_amount, 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(refund_amount, 2) AS refund_amount, ROUND(net_income, 2) AS net_income FROM level_summary ORDER BY user_level LIMIT 200

payload.sql: WITH user_order_summary AS (SELECT u.user_level, u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount), 0) AS user_sales_amount FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '72' DAY) GROUP BY u.user_level, u.user_id), user_refund_summary AS (SELECT u.user_level, u.user_id, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS user_refund_amount FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '72' DAY) GROUP BY u.user_level, u.user_id) SELECT uos.user_level, ROUND(SUM(uos.user_sales_amount), 2) AS sales_amount, ROUND(SUM(urs.user_refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount, ROUND(SUM(uos.user_sales_amount) - SUM(urs.user_refund_amount), 2) AS net_income FROM user_order_summary AS uos JOIN user_refund_summary AS urs ON uos.user_level = urs.user_level AND uos.user_id = urs.user_id GROUP BY uos.user_level ORDER BY uos.user_level LIMIT 200

payload.sql: WITH order_refunds AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.paid_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS total_refund_amount, COUNT(r.refund_id) AS refund_count FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '64' DAY) WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '64' DAY) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.paid_amount), filtered_orders AS (SELECT order_id, paid_amount, total_refund_amount, ROUND(total_refund_amount / NULLIF(paid_amount, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM order_refunds WHERE refund_count >= 2 AND total_refund_amount / NULLIF(paid_amount, 0) BETWEEN 0.10 AND 0.40) SELECT order_id, ROUND(paid_amount, 2) AS paid_amount, ROUND(total_refund_amount, 2) AS refund_amount, refund_rate FROM filtered_orders LIMIT 200
